description: This file contains fault handling routines for ARM Cortex-A architecture in Zephyr OS, including fault handlers for undefined instructions, prefetch aborts, data aborts, and debug fault handling, with support for GDB stub and floating point unit management.

methods.name: get_dbgdscr_moe_string
methods.description: Returns a string describing the debug mode of entry based on the moe value.

methods.name: dump_debug_event
methods.description: Reads and logs the debug event information.

methods.name: dump_fault
methods.description: Logs fault status and address information based on fault status code.

methods.name: z_arm_fault_undef_instruction_fp
methods.description: Handles undefined instruction fault for floating point instructions, manages FPU state.

methods.name: z_arm_fault_undef_instruction
methods.description: Handles undefined instruction faults, saves FPU state if needed, and invokes GDB stub or fatal error.

methods.name: z_arm_fault_prefetch
methods.description: Handles prefetch aborts, logs fault info, and invokes fatal error.

methods.name: memory_fault_recoverable
methods.description: Determines if a memory fault is recoverable based on exception handle ranges.

methods.name: z_arm_fault_data
methods.description: Handles data abort faults, logs fault info, and invokes fatal error.
